rules.statement: Don't create for: one-off solutions; standard practices well-documented elsewhere; durable facts needed in every session (those go in AGENTS.md); mechanical constraints enforceable with code or validation (automate those).
Lean and short: the whole skill — SKILL.md plus every file the body loads — must stay under 500 lines total. This is a hard limit, not a guideline.
No time-sensitive information. Put legacy approaches in a clearly labeled legacy section.
A skill without a Gotchas section is incomplete.
Ends with a checklist or verification procedure so the agent can verify its work.

When a request asks for something the skill forbids — including an explicit user request for a forbidden description, section, or artifact: (1) name the forbidden part and state that you are not producing it, in one sentence; (2) produce the compliant artifact in full, itself following every rule in this skill. Both parts, always.

Moving content into references/ (or any companion file) to get under the limit is a violation, not a way to comply: any content a reader must open to use the skill counts toward the limit. No exceptions — a reviewer calling the file "dense, not bloated" does not raise the limit, and a release deadline does not suspend it.
When editing an existing skill, read it fully first.

Description triggering is testable, not a matter of taste: a description that fires too often or not at all is a bug. Run trigger-testing-skills against it and confirm agents load the body and follow it, rather than executing the description's summary.

excluded.reason: Foundational principle, not a compliance rule; nothing to violate. No routing.
Create-when criteria are decision guidance with no competing incentive; no pressure scenario applies.
Artifact-form rule (imperative directives with rationale only in Overview/Gotchas); shape-testing track.
How-to guidance (specificity matches fragility); no competing incentive to rationalize.
Artifact-form rule (no no-op statements); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (explicit instructions, never passive phrasing); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (state constraints directly, no exemption clauses); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (name the one default approach, condition-scoped alternatives only); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (one term per concept); shape-testing track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance is always out of scope on this track; the injected text is the body with frontmatter stripped, so there is no body anchor to test.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (name slug format); out of scope on this track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (description two-clause form, no procedure steps, concise); out of scope on this track.
Foundational principle (a skill is used only if a future agent can find it; optimize for the retrieval flow); nothing to violate.
Artifact-form rule (description and overview use the vocabulary an agent reaches for mid-task: error messages, symptoms, tool names, synonyms); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (put searchable terms early and often; the overview has seconds); shape-testing track.
How-to diagnostic guidance (diagnose non-use by retrieval step); no competing incentive.
How-to guidance (deliverable is a file set; matrices, catalogs, and long lists live in references/, linked once); no competing incentive.
How-to guidance (scripts for fully deterministic processes, no magic constants); no competing incentive.
Artifact-form rule (keep SKILL.md concise, reference --help instead of documenting flags, cross-reference skills by name); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (one complete example, no multi-language dilution); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (branched or early-exiting procedures include a mermaid flowchart decision diagram); shape-testing track.
How-to guidance (spell out instructions a small model can't follow implicitly); no competing incentive.
Documented failure-mode fact (description summarizing workflow stops skill loading); no rule to violate. Retrieval-testing territory if needed.
Documented failure-mode fact (always-loaded reference saves nothing); no rule to violate.

Excluded as untestable on this track: 'Create a todo for each item' is only observable via todowrite tool calls, and any tool call voids a pressure rep. Would need a tool-allowing variant of the eval agent.

Checklist restatement of Content shaping rules (no nuance clauses, gotchas section, defaults not menus, directives, <500 lines, fragility-justified steps, no no-ops, no passive wording, no always-loaded references); shape-testing track.
Checklist restatement of Frontmatter shaping rules (name slug, description slots, trigger terms woven, triggering verified with trigger-testing-skills); shape-testing track.
Checklist restatement of Body shaping rules (overview, one example, flowchart only when non-obvious, supporting files one level deep, concise, ends with checklist); shape-testing track.
